description: This file provides an in-memory implementation of the AppRepository interface, offering hardcoded sample values for titles and initial counters for different screens in an Android app following MVVM architecture.

classes.name: InMemoryAppRepository
classes.description: A class that implements AppRepository with in-memory hardcoded data for UI components.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title associated with a given screen key, defaults to 'Screen' if not found.

methods.name: getInitialCounter
methods.description: Returns the initial counter value for a given screen key, defaults to 0 if not found.
